discovery_index.name: Sabino football-statistics research sources
discovery_index.role: Discovery and corroboration index; not parsed by the unattended build.

limitations: Coverage varies by competition and period. Source routes can overlap and do not count as separate competitions.
Recent results and season corrections update automatically. GSA season backfill advances in bounded round batches and reports its progress.
Unresolved identities, score phases, venues and incomplete source pages remain visible and cannot silently become results.
Historical world coverage is incomplete. Rating peaks compare estimates on a changing historical reference, not absolute playing strength across eras.
